title: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
Live updates: Bitcoin holding $76,000, Nasdaq bounces ahead of U.S. jobs data
summary: Nasdaq 100 futures were higher by 1.5% following Thursday's 5.5% rout. Japan's Nikkei and Korea's Kospi each slumped 6% overnight.

title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
summary: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
summary: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.
